codeSystems.name: TAWorkflowBusinessStatusVS
codeSystems.title: TA Workflow Business Status
codeSystems.description: Codes for Task.businessStatus of the Coordination Task under TA Workflow. Extensible: a use case MAY define further values; selected is set by the Placer only.

codeSystems.name: TAWorkflowStatusReasonVS
codeSystems.title: TA Workflow Status Reason
codeSystems.description: Codes for Task.statusReason of the Coordination Task under TA Workflow. Extensible: a use case or a Fulfiller MAY use other reasons, for instance when it rejects a Task; not-selected is reserved for the Placer.

codeSystems.name: TAWorkflowTaskCodeVS
codeSystems.title: TA Workflow Task Code
codeSystems.description: Codes for Task.code of the Coordination Task under TA Workflow.
